problem_statement:
Multi-column Parquet write inefficiencies
Passing along a comment from another developer. " I've noticed that Parquet output from Arkouoda is currently very slow. The Arkouda client library saves multi-column dataframes by sending a separate writeParquet request to the server for each column, adding them to the file one-by-one. The ccp_appendColumnToParquet function doesn't add the column to the file in-place, though; instead it loads the whole existing file into memory, adds the new column to the table object in memory, and overwrites the whole file with the new version. That means it's loading and re-saving the content of all the old columns each time it adds a new one, which adds a lot of overhead since this happens for every column."
